bengal.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: one catalog/configurator pilot image of the CORAZON funerary monument. Image 1 is the exact monument geometry reference; image 2 is the BENGAL granite texture reference. Reproduce the complete monument from image 1 as a clean isolated studio product render. Preserve the large asymmetrical heart headstone with its left lobe higher and narrower than the right lobe, deep central cleft, point at lower left, polished bevel and substantial stone thickness. Preserve exactly the three stacked tapering curved fan-shaped stone forms below the heart, fanning out toward the right from the same lower-left point, and their rounded right tips. They are structural parts, not ornaments. Keep the rear horizontal support block, long rectangular raised slab with rounded bevels, two longitudinal side rails with rounded front tops, recessed front step and broad flat rectangular plinth. Preserve all actual component proportions, junctions and thicknesses. Every component is stone in the same BENGAL granite: charcoal grey with dense fine black, grey and white mineral grains as in image 2, at realistic scale. Remove the engraved cross, flower and leaf engraving from the heart, with no residue. No inscription, symbols, decoration, flowers, vase or loose accessories. Reorient the camera to be exactly centered on the monument longitudinal axis, with zero left-right yaw, the front headstone face parallel to the image plane. Use a parallel orthographic projection with modest camera elevation sufficient to show the full upper slab and steps. Front edges must be horizontal, side rails symmetrical in perspective, no three-quarter view. Entire monument visible with balanced margins in a square image. Uniform pale grey studio background and floor, soft contact shadow, gentle balanced studio lighting, polished stone with restrained reflections. Do not invent or omit structural parts. Requested output 2048 x 2048. This is the fixed geometry master for all nine subsequent material-only edits.
bengal.controleVisuel: Controle visuel: coeur asymetrique, trois courbes en eventail, support, dalle, rails, marche et plinthe conserves ; gravures supprimees ; matiere coherente avec la texture et cadrage stable entre variantes. Vue frontale centree avec convergence perspective residuelle ; projection non strictement orthographique. PNG original 1254 x 1254 ; calibration, echelle du grain et format final >=1600 non valides.
